terra.problem: The imagined neighborhood meeting and its length add an event the text does not describe. Marking it as a bet does not make an invented event a feeling guess.
“Same king” identifies the king in verse 6 with the king in verse 24, but the passage does not establish that they are the same person.
The joke about blaming the lions makes light of people being killed.
The joke puts an official “in charge of the God of the land,” then uses that premise for a comparison. It also does not match the action of sending someone to teach.
Comparing the making of other gods to sneaking a different recipe into an oven makes light of serious sin.
The text does not say that nobody is building a town. It says the settlers lived in existing towns and made their own gods.
“It wasn't a short list” adds a claim about the number of priests. The text says they appointed priests of all sorts, not how many.
“Along with the suitcases” adds a modern detail to the settlers’ move as though it were part of the biblical scene.
